status: REVIEWED ARTIFACT, NEVER EXECUTED. Every value marked (V) is chosen and verified by the reviewer on the build host; nothing here is a verified fact.

base.suite: (V) a Debian stable suite, e.g. bookworm
base.snapshotTimestamp: (V) a snapshot.debian.org timestamp, so the same recipe yields the same packages (reproducible)
base.note: no package manager, no compiler, no network client, no git: a sandbox cannot install or fetch anything inside the rootfs

toolchain.mount: /toolchain (read-only bind mount from the node's toolchain directory)

node.sha256: (V) from the reviewer's own verification of the release's SHASUMS256.txt signature

toolchain.npm: the npm that ships with that Node release (never self-updated)

globalPackages.lockfile: infra/runtime/rootfs/toolchain/package-lock.json (generated on the build host with `npm install --package-lock-only`, reviewed, committed; the build refuses without it)

files./usr/local/etc/npmrc: infra/runtime/rootfs/npmrc (global npm config: registry, proxy, ignore-scripts=true, no update notifier; the constant environment cannot override it)
files./home/sandbox: empty, mode 0755 (HOME in the constant environment); the root file system is read-only at run time, so it is only a path

dependencyPolicy.install: lockfile only: `npm ci --ignore-scripts` (the `install-deps` profile); the control plane refuses git/url/path/alias dependencies and missing integrity hashes before any network call (dependency-policy.ts); npm itself verifies every tarball against the lockfile's integrity hash
dependencyPolicy.lifecycleScripts: never: ignore-scripts=true in the global npmrc AND `--ignore-scripts` in the fixed argv AND `run-script` refuses lifecycle names
dependencyPolicy.registry: only the mirror/registry host(s) of the dependency policy, reached through the egress proxy

output.layout: an unpacked directory tree, owned by root, no setuid/setgid files, no device nodes, no sockets
output.digest: node packages/runtime-agent/dist/tree-digest-cli.js <rootfs-dir>  ->  sha256:<hex>  (the image digest the attestation and agent.json list; the agent recomputes it at every start)
output.sbom: (V) `syft dir:<rootfs> -o spdx-json` and a vulnerability scan, attached to the evidence
output.signature: (V) the digest is signed by the build host's release key; the node verifies before first use
